buildings.name: Goldsmith Hall
buildings.observations: Limestone studio hall, broad divided glazing and an enclosed planted court; retain the actual court opening.

buildings.name: Sutton Hall
buildings.observations: Pale arcaded lower floor, warm brick upper floors, inset divided windows and tiled roof.

buildings.name: Homer Rainey Hall
buildings.observations: Pale classical hall with tall divided windows, limestone base and emphatic cornice.

buildings.name: Calhoun Hall
buildings.observations: Pale limestone walls and deep regular punched openings.

buildings.name: Parlin Hall
buildings.observations: Compact limestone hall with lower arched openings and divided upper sashes.

buildings.name: West Mall Office Building
buildings.observations: Regular stone-framed sashes in a pale, shallow office block.

buildings.name: Peter T. Flawn Academic Center
buildings.observations: Deep light-stone screens above a recessed glazed base; no ordinary sash grid on the screen.

buildings.name: Hogg Memorial Auditorium
buildings.observations: Mostly blank limestone auditorium, tall recessed entry bays and a heavy cornice.

buildings.name: Biological Laboratories
buildings.observations: Warm brick above a pale base, small divided windows, broad stone cornice.

buildings.name: Mary E. Gearing Hall
buildings.observations: Light limestone U-shaped hall framing a garden and central fountain approach.

buildings.name: T. S. Painter Hall
buildings.observations: Brick academic block above limestone base; short divided sash windows.

buildings.name: Dorothy Gebauer Building
buildings.observations: Warm pale walls, upper round-headed openings and prominent stone frieze.

buildings.name: Will C. Hogg Building
buildings.observations: Warm brick, pale stone ground course and divided windows.

buildings.name: Garrison Hall
buildings.observations: Brick upper walls, limestone base, deep window surrounds; sculpted entrance remains simplified.

buildings.name: Waggener Hall
buildings.observations: Orange brick with narrow tall sashes and a pale upper frieze.

buildings.name: Burdine Hall
buildings.observations: Orange brick classroom wings interrupted by broad blank stair walls.

buildings.name: Pharmacy Building
buildings.observations: Tan brick, pale trim and regular inset sash windows.

buildings.name: Anna Hiss Gymnasium
buildings.observations: Tall round-headed gym glazing in low red-brick walls, not stacked office floors.

buildings.name: Andrews Dormitory
buildings.observations: Buff brick, light stone lower arcades and divided dormitory sashes.

buildings.name: Blanton Dormitory
buildings.observations: Buff brick residence wing, pale sash surrounds, courtyard-facing windows.

buildings.name: Carothers Dormitory
buildings.observations: Warm buff brick, pale courses and white dormitory sashes around the northern quad.

buildings.name: Littlefield Dormitory
buildings.observations: Warmer brick residence with lower arcades and a pronounced pale cornice.

buildings.name: Brackenridge Hall Dormitory
buildings.observations: Tan brick, pale corner/base courses, narrow white sashes around the residence court.

buildings.name: Roberts Hall
buildings.observations: Tan-brick residence wing with stone court entries and divided sash glazing.

buildings.name: Prather Hall
buildings.observations: Buff brick and light stone courses, small windows overlooking planted courts.

buildings.name: Moore-Hill Dormitory
buildings.observations: Long brick residence wing with five close-spaced rows and pale window frames.

buildings.name: Bernard and Audre Rapoport Building
buildings.observations: Three-storey brick academic hall above a light ground course.

buildings.name: E. P. Schoch Building
buildings.observations: Brick laboratory block with large blank volumes and a windowed three-storey wing.

buildings.name: F Loren Winship Drama Building
buildings.observations: Brick theater masses with blank stage walls and a glazed lower entry.

buildings.name: Art Building and Museum
buildings.observations: Large blank brick gallery walls; windows are limited to the office-wing faces.

buildings.name: Student Services Building
buildings.observations: Stone-framed grid over brick infill; rooftop colonnade retained where present in existing roof detail.

buildings.name: Sarah M. and Charles E. Seay Building
buildings.observations: Brick and broad glazing beneath a shallow hipped roof.

buildings.name: Louise and James Robert Moffett Molecular Biology Building
buildings.observations: Long pale four-storey laboratory wing with expressed stair towers.

buildings.name: Creekside Residence Hall
buildings.observations: Low tan-brick residence hall with simple sash windows.

buildings.name: Neural Molecular Science Building
buildings.observations: Modern brick and light stone laboratory grid under an overhanging roof.

buildings.name: Biomedical Engineering Building
buildings.observations: Brick laboratory mass with pale frame and broad recessed glazing.
